map.由数值序列求平均绝对偏差 使用指南: Mean absolute deviation from a value sequence guide
map.输入一组数值，按 MAD = Σ|xᵢ − x̄|/n 计算平均绝对偏差，衡量数: Enter a set of values and compute the mean absolute deviation by MAD = sum of |xi - x_bar|/n, measuring average dispersion, for forecast error and robustness assessment.
map.MAD=Σ|x−μ|/n，平均距离。: MAD = sum of |x - mu| / n, the average distance.
map.比标准差更易解释（同量纲）。: Easier to interpret than the standard deviation (same units).
map.：μ=5；MAD=(|2−5|+|4−5|+|6−5|+|8−5|)/4=(3+: : mu = 5; MAD = (|2-5| + |4-5| + |6-5| + |8-5|)/4 = (3+1+1+3)/4 = 2. On average each value sits 2 away from the mean.
map.：同上 σ=√5≈2.236，MAD=2 略小（对极值不平方放大）。: : likewise sigma = sqrt(5), about 2.236, while MAD = 2 is slightly smaller (extremes are not squared and amplified).
map.MAD 和标准差区别？: How does MAD differ from the standard deviation?
map.MAD 用绝对偏差均值，标准差用平方后开方（放大离群）；MAD 更稳健易解释。: MAD uses the mean of absolute deviations, while the standard deviation squares then takes the root (amplifying outliers); MAD is more robust and easier to interpret.
map.还有一种 MAD=median(|x−median|)，抗离群更强，二者不同，注: There is also MAD = median(|x - median|), which resists outliers even more; the two differ, so keep them distinct.
